instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend using React js components with Tailwind CSS.
Ensure mobile-first design targeting responsive width (max-w-md for mobile frame view or full fluid viewport on actual mobile devices).
Implement gesture support for the Instagram-story carousel (touch drag / swipe left & right, tap sides for previous/next).
All components must be written in .js / .jsx files.
Include PWA manifest and service worker registration capability so the app prompts 'Añadir a pantalla de inicio' in browsers.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when copying share links or downloading images.
Make the Chile national theme ('Dieciochero 🇨🇱') super authentic with warm festive accents and Chilean phrases like '¡Tiki tiki ti!', 'Aperrado', 'Regalón máximo'.
Provide a simulated instant Webpay payment completion flow for 3.990 CLP with real state updates.
Store generated stories in localStorage / mock backend state so user can refresh and view their story or test admin analytics.
Make admin dashboard accessible via footer link or /admin route with password 'cuentapatas2026'.
